Accomplishment
1. Dr. Long Song Lin was awarded the Yushan Overseas Community Affairs Professional Medal (林榮松醫師獲頒玉山僑務專業獎章) 2019

2. President of Taiwan Center Foundation/Greater Los Angeles (大洛杉磯台灣會館董事長) 2016-2017

3. President of North American Taiwanese Association (NATMA) (北美洲台灣人醫師協會總會會長) 2000-2001

4. President of NATMA Southern California Chapter (北美洲台灣人醫師協會南加州分會會長)

5. Photo coordinator of A Decade of Serving the Needy 2003-2014 (北美洲台灣人醫師協會國際義診十周年紀念專輯照片組召集人)

6. Published many Articles in Taiwanese American Newspapers, Newsletters, and Magazines

7. Outstanding Taiwanese American Elected by T.A. Archives in 10/2018
